units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 5:4">Ab. Zar. V, 4</cite> <he>המניח יינו בק׳ וכ׳</he> if a person left his wine in a coach … and walked on a short-cut (leaving the wine under the care of a gentile driver) &c.; Y. ib. 44ᵈ bot. <he>מעשה בק׳ … שהפליגה וכ׳</he> it happened with a coach of the house of Rabbi that its passenger left it unwatched for more than four miles.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 8:3">Kil. VIII, 3</cite> <he>היושב בק׳</he> he that sits in a coach (drawn by heterogeneous animals).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:1">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> a general saw them <he>ומושיב אותן בק׳</he> and made them sit in his coach; Pesik. Vatt. p. 133ᵃ <he>על קרונין שלו</he> (read <cite ref="S01943"><he>קָרוּכִין</he></cite> or <cite ref="S01951"><he>קרון</he></cite>). Lev. R. l. c. <he>הק׳ עוברת וכ׳</he> the coach passed over them &c.; Pesik. l. c. 133ᵇ <he>הקרונין</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:18">Lam. R. to IV, 15</cite> <he>קרונין</he>, <he>קירונין</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.—Pl. <he>קְרוֹנוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 122a:2">Sabb. 122ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ של בית רבי וכ׳</he> the light coaches of the house of Rabbi may be moved on the Sabbath.
<cite ref="Shabbat 122a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>לשתות יין בק׳ של נכרים וכ׳</he> to drink wine carried with him in coaches (and left temporarily in charge of gentiles), v. supra.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 76b:17">Kidd. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ של זהב</he> Ar. (ed. <he>קְרוֹנִיּוֹת</he>, fr. <cite ref="S01948"><he>קְרוֹנִית</he></cite>) gilt coaches.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:2">Cant. R. to V, 2</cite> <he>שיהו עגלות וקְרָנִיּוֹת וכ׳</he> (fr. <cite ref="S02109"><he>קְרָנִית</he></cite>) wide enough for wagons and coaches to pass.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 75:10">Gen. R. s. 75</cite> <he>יושבי קְרָנוֹת</he> (fr. <cite ref="S02102"><he>קֶרֶן</he></cite>?) sitting in coaches; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 130:17">Yalk. ib. 130</cite>. B. B. 146ᵃ <he>מאה ק׳ וכ׳</he> one hundred wagon loads &c.; Y. ib. IX, 17ᵃ <he>קריות</he> (corr. acc.).—V. <cite ref="S01952">next w.</cite>
